title: Formatting, clippy 60-line limit, and test-tampering pitfalls when refactoring tests
what:
- rustfmt.toml sets use_small_heuristics="Max", and CI runs `cargo fmt --all -- --check`. clippy.toml sets too-many-lines-threshold = 60 and CI uses -D warnings, so formatting can push a function over the limit. Split it by extracting phases into helpers or by moving data into constants; never raise the threshold.
- The no-test-tampering rule counts assertion lines, including `assert_ok(`. Wrapping assertions in a helper looks like removed assertions; move blocks verbatim instead.
- Every path under a tests/ directory is treated as a test file, so data fixtures (for example slop benchmark .case files) live outside tests/, in crates/anvil-cli/slop_bench.
why: These rules blocked a commit twice while formatting the workspace and while building the benchmark.
learned: Why fixtures sit outside tests/: the tampering check treats tests/ as tests. Fix too_many_lines by splitting functions, not by allowing.
author: reactive-end
